tools.name: define_term
tools.description: The definition of one gemology term (for example 'crown angle', 'feather', 'fluorescence', 'scintillation', 'birefringence', 'cut grade'): a short definition, more detail, where it appears on a grading report, how Digital Gemology measures it, related terms, and its page.

tools.name: search_glossary
tools.description: Find glossary terms by a word or a question (for example 'what do the girdle words mean', 'inclusions near the surface', 'why does a diamond sparkle'). Returns each match with its definition and page.

tools.name: list_glossary
tools.description: Every term in the glossary, or in one topic, with a one-line definition and its page. The topics: Grading report, Four Cs, Anatomy and proportions, Clarity characteristics, Color and fluorescence, Light performance, How we measure, Optics, Gem testing, Gemstone properties, Colored gemstones, Treatme
